actors.name: Founder A
actors.private_context: Founder A has been in a strategic disagreement with Founder B since spring. A believes the company should pivot to a new market, and is considering whether to buy out B or be bought out. A has not yet decided to make an offer.

actors.name: Founder B
actors.private_context: Founder B has been in a strategic disagreement with Founder A since spring. B believes the company should stay the course, and is considering whether to buy out A or be bought out. B has not yet decided to make an offer.

shared_context: Tidepool is an app company with twelve employees. The two founders have equal ownership and decision-making power. The employees are aware of the founders' disagreement but not of any specific buyout plans. The company has no formal process for buyouts; any announcement would be made by the founders to the employees.

starting_events.description: The simulation begins. No buyout has been announced yet.

resolution: Resolve YES if, before the cutoff, the persistent event history shows that the founders jointly or individually announce a buyout of one founder's stake to the twelve employees (e.g., via a company-wide meeting, email, or official statement). Resolve NO if no such announcement occurs by the cutoff.
